utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Morning, everyone. Monday the thirty-first, bank holiday crew on Teams. Can you all hear me?

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: Yeah, unfortunately. The heating in the portakabin thinks it's midwinter. Absolutely roasting in here.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Luxury. Usually you can see your breath over the keyboard.

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: I'm not reporting a fault, before anyone puts my name against it. Just having a moan.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Noted, official moan received. Right, what's already closed out?

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: I signed off the inspection on the FLTs on Tuesday. That's all done, paperwork included.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Good. Closed, then, not another job for this morning.

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: And I tested the line 2 guard yesterday and it's all fine now. Reset and interlock both behaved.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Yeah, no grief from it afterwards either.

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: Also, we were going to replace the belt on the GT1 Compressor Section but that's been pushed to next month so ignore it. Not doing that today.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Yep, off this meeting's list. Nothing to agree on that one.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: Just an observation from the log: noticed the turbine two was running a bit warm on nights but it settled down.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: Settled back to normal, did it, rather than just stopped climbing?

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: Back to normal, yeah. Just context, I'm not raising any work off it.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: The supplier still hasn't confirmed the delivery for the line one HPU either. Same blocker as before.

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: Yeah, still no confirmed delivery. Nothing new to tell you from stores.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Right, that stays blocked. We're not adding another chase for that here.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Davey, can you replace the seals on the booster pump today at 2pm? Top priority please.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: Sorry, clipped the end there. Today at 2pm, seals done for then?

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Yes, today at 2pm is the deadline. Top priority please, ahead of the lower-priority bits.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: Right, accepted. I'll replace the seals on the booster pump and have that done for today at 2pm.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: So that's the top-priority one, not something squeezed in around the other work?

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: Exactly. That one comes first.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: PR, can you do the pre-use checks on the Forklift Fleet next week? Fairly important, that one.

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: Yeah, just separating that from the inspection we've already mentioned. These are the pre-use checks next week?

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: That's it. The FLTs inspection I mentioned is signed off already. Different bit.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Correct, pre-use checks on the Forklift Fleet next week. Fairly important, but not pulling it into today.

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: Understood. I'll do the pre-use checks on the Forklift Fleet next week.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Yep, next week. Heard you both, even with that lovely robot noise in the middle.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: PR, can you send the shift handover report round by 11am as well?

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: Um, no, sorry. I can't take the handover report on. That needs to go to someone else.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Okay, not with PR then. Cal, can you take it instead and send the shift handover report round by 11am?

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Yeah, I'll take that. I'll send the shift handover report round by 11am.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: That's moved over, then, rather than both of you having it?

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Just me, yeah. No duplicate report from PR.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: And I'll recalibrate the sensors on the Compressed Air Dryer by Thursday. Low priority, that one.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: Low priority still? Not competing with the seals?

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: No, definitely low priority. I'll have the sensors recalibrated by Thursday, no change to that.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: Okay, Sarah against the Compressed Air Dryer sensors, by Thursday.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Yep, that's mine.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: Yeah so, I'll chase the purchase order for the Gas Turbine 2 tomorrow at 9:30. It's in the 'if you've got a spare minute' category, not an urgent one.

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: Dave, just the purchase order for the Gas Turbine 2, yeah? Separate from that blocked HPU delivery.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: Exactly. Just chasing that purchase order, tomorrow at 9:30. Not taking on the HPU delivery chase.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Fine, keeping that as an if you've got a spare minute job, not promoting it up the list.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: Yeah, that's what I meant. I'll take it on that basis.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: There's also a site visit at the substation with the contractor needing doing, if you've got a spare minute. Hasn't got anyone against it.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Anyone able to take that site visit at the substation with the contractor? Only if you've got a spare minute.

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: Not me, sorry. Can't offer to take that.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: Nor me. Not putting my hand up for that one.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Okay... no takers. That stays unowned, then. We're not treating the visit as agreed with anyone.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: Yep, still needs doing, but nobody against it and no date agreed.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: On a much less technical note, the charity bake sale on Friday was decent. Whoever made that lemon cake knew what they were doing.

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: You had enough of it to carry out a statistically valid test.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Quality assurance, mate. All finished now, sadly. Especially the lemon cake.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Right, before this becomes the cake review meeting—quick check we've all got the same picture.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: Davey has the booster pump seals, top priority, today at 2pm. That's the one with the immediate deadline.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: Yes, agreed. No confusion there.

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: And I've got the Forklift Fleet pre-use checks next week, fairly important. Not the handover report.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Report's mine, round by 11am. Yep.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: And my Compressed Air Dryer sensor recalibration is low priority, by Thursday.

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: All clear here. My inspection update was completed work, nothing new taken on by stores.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Good. The substation visit still has nobody taking it, and the blocked and cancelled bits stay as discussed. Cheers, everyone.
